newsitem.title: USA: Waxman says Barnett files for shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Waxman says Barnett files for shr offering.

text.p: Waxman Industries Inc said Thursday its affiliate Barnett Inc filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a secondary public offering of about 2 million common shares.
Waxman said in a release that of the two million shares, 500,000 will be sold by Barnett and 1.5 million shares will be sold by Waxman USA Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary of Waxman Industries.

Net proceeds of the offering to Waxman USA will be used to reduce indebtedness of Waxman, and net proceeds of the offering to Barnett will be used to repay short term debt and for general corporate purposes, the release said.
Waxman said the offering will be co-managed by William Blair & Co and Alex Brown & Sons Inc.
